build_single_stage_segmentor: build a SingleStageInstanceSegmentor with backbone, neck, bbox_head, and mask_head configurations
extract_features_single_stage: extract multi-level features from input images using the backbone and neck network
forward_single_stage_seg: run the forward pass through backbone, bbox_head, and mask_head without post-processing
compute_loss_single_stage: compute bbox and mask loss components for training single-stage instance segmentation
predict_instance_masks: predict instance segmentation masks with scores, labels, bboxes, and masks on input images
